operations.title: Show Indexing Errors
operations.description: Show resources that failed search indexing for the current tenant and project.

parameters.name: resolve
parameters.documentation: If true, mark the indexing errors as resolved.

parameters.name: errors
parameters.documentation: The resources that failed search indexing.

parts.name: id
parts.documentation: Version id of the resource that failed to index.

parts.name: version_id
parts.documentation: Version id of the resource that failed to index.

parts.name: resource_type
parts.documentation: FHIR resource type of the resource that failed to index.

parts.name: fhir_method
parts.documentation: The operation (create, update or delete) that failed to index.

parts.name: sequence
parts.documentation: Sequence position of the resource in the indexing stream.

parts.name: attempt_count
parts.documentation: Number of times indexing has been attempted for this resource.

parts.name: error_message
parts.documentation: The error that occurred while indexing.

parts.name: first_failed_at
parts.documentation: When this resource first failed indexing.

parts.name: last_failed_at
parts.documentation: When this resource most recently failed indexing.

parts.name: resolved_at
parts.documentation: When this failure was marked resolved, if it has been.

operations.title: ViewDefinition Run
operations.description: Execute a view definition against supplied or server data.

parameters.name: _format
parameters.documentation: Output format for the result (for example json, ndjson, csv, parquet). Optional; if omitted, the server returns ndjson by default.

parameters.name: header
parameters.documentation: Include CSV headers (default true). Applies only when csv output is requested.

parameters.name: viewReference
parameters.documentation: Reference to a ViewDefinition stored on the server.

parameters.name: viewResource
parameters.documentation: Inline ViewDefinition resource to execute.

parameters.name: patient
parameters.documentation: Restrict execution to the specified patient.

parameters.name: group
parameters.documentation: Restrict execution to members of the given group(s).

parameters.name: source
parameters.documentation: External data source to use (for example a URI or bucket name).

parameters.name: resource
parameters.documentation: FHIR resources to transform instead of using server data.

parameters.name: _limit
parameters.documentation: Maximum number of rows to return.

parameters.name: _since
parameters.documentation: Include only resources modified after this instant.

parameters.name: return
parameters.documentation: Transformed data encoded in the requested output format.
